scope: Independent readonly review of frozen low-step publisher, replay and instructions. No publication/replay/controller import or execution, Docker, SSH, training, GPU or scientific task.

publication_contract.exclusive_creation: publish.py:35-50 rejects any existing target, then mkdir(exist_ok=False); partial publication remains on error, without retry or replacement.
publication_contract.actual_evidence_gates: publish.py:38-49 requires independent postexecution review passed/no must-fix, all five actual phase wait0, host attached wait0, container exit0/nonrunning, unchanged source; every review evidence fingerprint rechecked.
publication_contract.raw_preservation: publish.py:52-86 copies source/control/input/report/log/inspect/transfer and terminal-observation bytes exclusively; source/destination SHA and byte counts compared before/after copy. JSON absolute paths remain unchanged, with separate path-map.
publication_contract.no_false_failure_or_science_claim: New low-step cpu-01 only; does not invent old CPU failures. Source-original/diffs retain provenance. Index explicitly says CPU artifact acceptance, not physical/convergence/PT-ONNX parity or whole-schedule completion.

regular_copy_inventory.note: Static source enumeration only; actual publication file count and gzip compression output are not yet known.

publication_contract.external_onnx: Exact 428920342-byte original remains external with original remote/local path and SHA. Publisher hashes it against actual inventory; replay checks exact bytes before Docker action.

event_contract.gzip: mtime0, empty filename, compresslevel9; if needed split at decimal25000000 bytes with continuous offsets and SHA for every chunk.
event_contract.full_restoration_gate: Sequential decompression consumes every chunk; checks chunk identity/offset, gzip EOF/no trailing stream, compressed whole size/SHA, restored full original size/SHA and source unchanged.
event_contract.replay_gate: Same complete streaming checks plus actual restored event file fingerprint; no shortened event or scalar substitution.

replay_contract.namespace_and_inputs: replay.py:117-157 restores same five actual artifact names, including identical baseline copies in restored /artifacts and published /control. Every original input-manifest record resolves to original /control or restored /artifacts and must match size/SHA.
replay_contract.baseline: Original low-step remote_artifacts_before metadata contains model_00000; copy SHA0eeeecfc7c7bc71ef8ee6b1a6a5cd1ffe61362598c2af38e146b5926df05f8dc. CPU checkpoint source additionally pins it and requires complete baseline/final experiment_config equality.
replay_contract.source_reuse: Original four frozen CPU source files and original input manifest, mounted readonly at identical native paths. No old ignored workspace path is required by the invoked five-phase runner.
replay_contract.fresh_outputs: restore/run each requires a fresh nonsymlink output outside publication; no automatic download, retry, overwrite or mutation of archived inputs.
replay_contract.isolation: Fixed existing image2be; runc/init/networknone; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty and NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES void; no --gpus; 2CPU/12g; 3RO inputs and new RW validation output.
replay_contract.terminal_gate: Actual attached child wait0, container not running/exit0, all five phase wait0, reconstructed inputs unchanged and complete package reverified. Cleanup references only freshly created full CID+image+name; output/logs retained, no foreign signals or rm.

static_credential_scan.scope: Readable copied evidence and preparation text, before this new review file; not arbitrary binary contents or full historical project.

limitations: Static review does not claim that publication, event gzip restoration or published replay have executed successfully. Root must retain actual invocation exits and verify final manifest after publication.
CPU artifact acceptance is separate from official cloud physics evaluation, remaining teachers/students,888 source attempts and final58 native evaluation.
